text:
Maya: Short sync: we need a final GA acceptance artifact that covers SLAs, Console surface, monitoring alert thresholds + runbooks, and pricing notes (burst vs reserved). Owners?
Owen: I'll own the SLA table wording. Proposal: Bronze = best-effort; Silver = 95th <= 120ms; Gold = 95th <= 80ms AND 99th <= 200ms. Gold scoped to Dedicated/Reserved only. Need legal to sign off on credit language.
Lina: Monitoring owner here. Recommend per-route 95th + error% for Silver/Gold, global only for Bronze. Alerting: page when 95th > target for 3m OR error_rate > 0.5% for 5m. Adding synthetic probes (5m) + 72h canary pre-GA. Runbook: https://wiki/redwood/sre/ga-runbook.
Priya: Docs: I'll produce the 1-pager "What your SLA means" and a Console mock with where metrics appear. Also include an FAQ: "When do we see per-route metrics?" and "What is best-effort?"
Frank: Billing: Reserved customers (Dedicated) get 10% unit discount + throughput guarantees. Hosted/burst customers are best-effort; overage billed at published rate. If sustained >10% above quota for 24h we may throttle. I'll draft the invoice footnote.
Aj: Engineering notes: per-route telemetry for Private installs behind a feature flag called route_metrics (default off for Private). We will add a per-customer toggle for fallback_to_variant; default off. PR inbound in 48h.
Maya: Can we show per-route 95th and error% in Console for Silver+ by GA?
Priya: Yes, mockups will show per-route rows with 95th and error% columns. For Bronze we'll show an aggregate latency card only.
Lina: Alert example (PromQL-style) for runbook:

alert: route_slo_violation
expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, route)) > ROUTE_THRESHOLD
for: 3m

And error alert:

alert: route_error_rate
expr: sum(rate(request_errors_total[5m])) by (route) / sum(rate(requests_total[5m])) by (route) > 0.005
for: 5m

Add muted windows during deploys.
Owen: SLA credits: propose simple formula + example in doc. Credit = (failed_minutes / minutes_in_month) * monthly_fee * SLA_weight. Finance must approve numbers.
Frank: I'll confirm credit calc with finance and post final wording in 24h.
Aj: Also: when fallback_to_variant triggers, tag requests with fallback=true so analytics and billing can filter. We'll add telemetry tags in the PR.
Priya: Docs action items: 1) SLA 1-pager + example invoice language (48h). 2) Console mockups (48h). 3) FAQ + "how to read your SLA" snippet (48h).
Lina: Monitoring action items: runbook + alert rules + canary job schedule (24h). I'll schedule canary for 2026-04-06 for 72h.
Aj: Engineering action items: route_metrics feature flag PR (48h), fallback API + tests (72h).
Maya: I'll consolidate everything into a single sign-off doc after these items land. ops-bot: maintenance window note?
ops-bot: Planned GA config push: 2026-04-10 02:00 UTC.
Maya: If anyone can't meet ETAs, flag here. Otherwise I'll circulate the consolidated doc tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
